what: Wikipedia disagrees with the PEO in several places: 2022 registered 86,658 vs PEO 87,566 (Wikipedia uses the list without police voters); 2022 GULP 64 vs PEO 66; 2016 registered 71,241 vs certificate 71,240; 2018 invalid 119 vs Gazette 116.
action: Wikipedia is used only as a cross-check, never as the source, from 1984 onward.
